name: ALTEOGEN Inc.
summary: ALTEOGEN Inc., a bio company, focuses on developing long-acting biobetters, proprietary antibody-drug conjugates, and antibody biosimilars. The company develops ALT-P1, a long-acting human growth hormone that is in the Phase IIa clinical trial; and ALT-Q2, a long-acting active form of coagulation factor VII for the treatment of hemophilia based on its NexP technology.
